regulatory_context.summary: A reporting entity must furnish a Suspicious Transaction Report to FIU-IND for any transaction or attempted transaction - cash or non-cash, regardless of value - that gives rise to reasonable grounds to suspect it involves proceeds of crime, has no apparent economic rationale, is structured to fall just below a reporting threshold, or is otherwise unusual for the client's profile; unlike the CTR, there is no monetary floor.
regulatory_context.applicability: Applies only when the case's determined jurisdiction is IN. Never conditioned on a specific transaction amount, unlike REG-IN-PMLA-CTR.
